nonStandardPatterns.pattern: defra-datepicker / date-picker__* / date-input--picker / date-picker__dialog / date-picker__button__* / date-picker__reveal__icon
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Bespoke DEFRA calendar-picker widget layered on the govuk date input — a 'Choose date' button reveals a month-grid dialog (Previous/Next month, Cancel) to pick the issue date.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Custom JS/CSS widget with its own dialog markup; not part of govuk-frontend. Adds a whole interactive component to build and a11y-test.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: GOV.UK Design System has no core datepicker — use the plain Date input (day/month/year) alone, or adopt the MoJ Frontend datepicker if a picker is genuinely required.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Bespoke CSS-grid layout used to render the document listings (catch certificates, health certificate, cloned, additional) and the inspector add-document row as column-aligned tables.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Hand-rolled grid instead of a semantic table; harder to make accessible and maintain; the column headers are plain generics not <th>.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: GOV.UK Table component for the read-only document listings; standard form-group rows for the add-document inputs.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Buttons styled to look like links ('Add attachment', 'Add another document', 'Download', 'Download all documents').
nonStandardPatterns.concern: A <button> or <a> given custom link-button styling rather than a standard component; visual/semantic intent is ambiguous.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: govuk-button with govuk-button--secondary for actions, or a plain govuk-link for navigation/download links.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom tertiary heading style used within the document sections.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Non-standard heading class rather than a govuk-heading-* size.

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: sr-only / short-date-input / aria-live-message / add-document-attachment / add-document-content / ellipsis
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Assorted utility/bespoke classes: sr-only duplicates govuk-visually-hidden; short-date-input sizes the date fields; aria-live-message is a live region for the datepicker; add-document-* wrap the inspector form; ellipsis truncates filenames.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Duplication of govuk utilities and project-specific helper classes outside the design system.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: govuk-visually-hidden for sr-only; govuk width overrides for sizing; govuk-!- spacing utilities.

fields.name: document-type
fields.label: Document type
fields.requiredEvidence: Conditionally mandatory as the old inspector system had it: once any metadata is entered, Add another document is submitted, or Add attachment is used, Joi requires a valid document-type value and returns "Select a document type" for missing, empty or invalid values (ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/validation/documents_validation.js:18-42). The blank row itself can be left untouched.
fields.evidence: trace 041c29c39002db28bc43ff85691f757cec6e31db action 162 (Inspector add-document form); default selected = 'Other'. QA corroboration: page-objects/notification/AccompanyingDocumentsPage.ts:7-9 locates the labelled select; workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:51-56 configures the document fields, :140-145 defaults the type to Commercial invoice and date to 04/03/2023, :356-359 drives the fields, and :940-944 selects Veterinary health certificate for the fish variant; types/document-type.ts:3 and :10 define those values.

fields.name: document-reference
fields.label: Document reference
fields.requiredEvidence: Conditionally mandatory with the same new-document trigger as document-type; Joi requires the reference and limits it to 32 characters (ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/validation/documents_validation.js:18-42).
fields.evidence: trace 041c29c39002db28bc43ff85691f757cec6e31db action 162 (fill 'INS-IMPORT'); trace 683661143a13d261e21f9f2552580756bc4d2350 action 156 (fill 'INS-UPLOAD'). QA corroboration: page-objects/notification/AccompanyingDocumentsPage.ts:11-13 locates the textbox; workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:53-56 declares the configurable reference/date, :141-145 supplies REF-124 and 04/03/2023, and :356-359 fills them.

fields.name: document-issue-date-day / document-issue-date-month / document-issue-date-year
fields.label: Document issue date
fields.requiredEvidence: Conditionally mandatory when a new inspector document is submitted. The document validator calls the date schema without the optional-date flag and with minYear 2020/maxYear 2050, so all three parts are required and must form a real date in that range (ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/validation/documents_validation.js:53-59,78-81; service/src/validation/date_validation.js:9-38,157-210).
fields.evidence: trace 041c29c39002db28bc43ff85691f757cec6e31db action 162 (legend 'Document issue date' visually-hidden, hint 'Day Month Year'); trace 683661143a13d261e21f9f2552580756bc4d2350 actions 157-159 (fill 16/07/2026). Also has a bespoke 'Choose date' datepicker. QA corroboration: page-objects/notification/AccompanyingDocumentsPage.ts:15-25 exposes separate Day, Month and Year textboxes and :47-51 fills them; workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:142-145 defaults them to 04/03/2023 and :359 applies that date.

fields.name: remove-attachment
fields.label: Remove attachment
fields.requiredEvidence: Optional per-row action. It is rendered only for a deletable inspector attachment before final status; the posted attachment id routes to the decision-side delete flow (ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/views/partials/bip/document/documentRow.html:65-76; service/src/routes/handlers/bip/documents.js:119-122,179-183).
fields.conditionalOn: an inspector document has a deletable attachment and the notification is not in a final status

fields.name: remove-additional-document
fields.label: Remove
fields.requiredEvidence: Optional per-row action for an inspector document without a removable attachment. The posted one-based row index is converted to an array index and removed (ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/views/partials/bip/document/documentRow.html:77-83; service/src/routes/handlers/bip/documents.js:141-146).
fields.conditionalOn: an inspector-added document row has no deletable attachment

openQuestions: Evidence pointer for the error state (trace 683661143a13d261e21f9f2552580756bc4d2350 action 20) was WRONG — action 20 is a 'Type of commodity' select on a commodity page, not the Attachments tab. The real invalid-empty-upload error renders on the 'Upload a document' sub-page at action 163 (alert 'The selected file is empty'), reached via Attachments tab (action 154) -> fill document-type/reference/date (155-159) -> Add attachment (160) -> set empty file (161) -> Continue (162). Used action 163 instead.

The Attachments 'Documents' page and the 'Upload a document' sub-page are two distinct pages sharing one workflow — the add-document row (type/reference/date + Add attachment) lives on the Documents page; the actual file picker + validation lives on the Upload sub-page. Both captured here.
Only 'Other' was observed as the selected document-type default; whether the empty 'Select document type' placeholder triggers its own required-validation was not exercised in these traces (gap).

LEGACY RESOLUTION: once any inspector document metadata is entered, Add another document is submitted, or Add attachment is used, document type is required and the empty/invalid copy is "Select a document type" (ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/validation/documents_validation.js:18-42; messages/en.js:3).

Required flags: all inspector add-document controls report required=false in the DOM (client-side); server-side conditional requirements (e.g. reference/date mandatory once a type is chosen) were not exercised — gap.

LEGACY RESOLUTION / POLICY POINT: for a new inspector document, type, reference, and the complete issue date are mandatory; the reference maximum is 32 characters and the issue year is restricted to 2020–2050 (ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/validation/documents_validation.js:18-59,78-81). This is the inspector-side rule as the old system had it and is stricter than notifier-side CHED-P additional documents, where reference/date are optional.
File-size (10MB) and file-type (DOC/JPEG/PDF/PNG/XLS) validation messages were not captured — only the empty-file error rendered; their exact copy is a gap.

LEGACY RESOLUTION: the upload service supplies exact empty-selection, type, size, empty-file and minimum-size messages (ipaffs-frontend-upload/service/src/utils/validation_constants.js:3-23; service/src/validation/file_upload_validation.js:73-110,159-169). As elsewhere, DOCX/XLSX are accepted but omitted from the display/error list, and the minimum-size copy says 1KB while the single-file validator threshold is actually 200 bytes; confirm corrected rebuild copy and thresholds.

The Importer section (catch certificates, latest health certificate, cloned documents, additional documents) is read-only display of the notifier's documents; the notifier-side upload flow was not exercised in these two traces.

The QA domain vocabulary is broader than the 14-option list rendered in the trace: types/document-type.ts:1-29 also defines values such as Cargo Manifest, Certificate of origin, Ingredients list, Packing list and Road consignment (CMR) note. The trace-confirmed option list is retained; confirm whether the broader values belong only to other CHED/document variants or can appear on this page.

The shared page object exposes a Success region and separate notifier/inspector attachment-link locators (page-objects/notification/AccompanyingDocumentsPage.ts:27-37), but the scoped CHED-P workflow only fills document metadata and continues without uploading an accompanying document (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:356-363). Exact success-banner copy and the post-upload state on this submitted-notification tab remain ambiguous.

The QA evidence names and drives the pre-submission Accompanying Documents page, while this spec covers the post-submission Documents/Attachments tab. The matching locators, inspector-specific #inspector-documents-table locator (page-objects/notification/AccompanyingDocumentsPage.ts:35-37), and rendered trace indicate a shared component, but the scoped CHED-P tests do not explicitly prove that every pre-submission behaviour is available on the post-submission tab.
